howItWorks.meta.title: How it works
howItWorks.meta.desc: The vouch loop, the two-track model, and our honest anti-sybil design.
howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: alvinmunk turns trust into something you can see — and other apps can read. Here's the whole machine, including the limits.
howItWorks.vouchLoop.title: The vouch loop
howItWorks.xpTracks.title: Two kinds of XP
howItWorks.social.label: track // social
howItWorks.social.title: Social XP
howItWorks.social.body: Earned from vouches. Powers your rank, leaderboard, and clout. It is {notCashable} — and that's on purpose.
howItWorks.earned.label: track // earned
howItWorks.earned.title: Earned XP
howItWorks.earned.body: Earned only from attester-verified quests. It is the {onlyTrack} that can unlock USDC rewards.
howItWorks.antiSybil.title: Anti-sybil, honestly
howItWorks.antiSybil.subtitle: We'd rather show you the limits than pretend they don't exist.
howItWorks.lim01.d: A repeated A→B vouch mints the card but grants 0 extra XP — no back-and-forth pumping.
howItWorks.lim02.d: A wallet can only mint so many vouches per day (on-chain counter).
howItWorks.lim03.d: Vouches earn clout, not cash. Only verified quests touch the treasury.
howItWorks.lim04.d: Reciprocal rings (A↔B) are flagged off-chain and can be frozen.
howItWorks.lim05.d: A per-reward amount + a global daily cap bound every payout.
howItWorks.lim06.d: On mainnet, a wallet must have received external value before it can cash out.
howItWorks.devs.title: For developers
howItWorks.devs.body: alvinmunk emits a canonical attestation primitive. Any app can read a wallet's reputation straight from the contract, with no API key and no backend.
